$ archo deps
external dependencies
  font:
    status: not installed
    path: <program>/fonts
    source: bundled
    error: the bundled font is missing
  todds:
    status: not installed
    error: todds is not installed
  steamcmd:
    status: installed
    path: $ROOT/LocalAppData/RimArcho/steamcmd/steamcmd.exe
    source: own
  wezterm:
    status: installed
    path: $ROOT/external/wezterm-gui.exe
    source: config

$ archo deps install unknown
error: unknown dependency "unknown" (known: [font todds steamcmd wezterm])
usage: archo deps install <name>
[exit 2]

$ archo deps install font
error: the font ships with RimArcho; reinstall the release zip
[exit 1]

$ archo deps remove wezterm
error: wezterm is not RimArcho's own copy; nothing removed
[exit 1]

$ archo deps remove steamcmd
removed steamcmd

$ archo deps install
error: wrong number of arguments
usage: archo deps install <name>
[exit 2]
